selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object class is indeed 'sock' and distinguish it from other tubular garments like leg warmers or sleeves.
To verify the socks are single continuous objects without AI-generated fusion errors at the toes or cuffs, and to check for boundary bleeding against the wood floor.
To analyze the consistency of the knit pattern. AI often fails to maintain logical stitch continuity around curves (heel/toe).
To ensure the socks sit naturally on the floor with correct shadowing and no floating artifacts.

focus_areas: Knit pattern continuity around the heel and toe curves
Boundary sharpness between sock fibers and wooden background
Symmetry and anatomical correctness of the sock structure (heel pocket, toe box)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the knit stitch logic. In AI images, stitches often 'melt' or become nonsensical near the heel turn.
